today.popupsBlocked: Your browser blocked some tabs. Allow pop-ups for {{host}} to open them all at once.

paste.label: Paste a result
paste.placeholder: Paste any game's share text here…
paste.help: Paste the share text from any of your games and the result fills in for you. For games you added yourself, use Log result on the card.
paste.notRecognized: Couldn't tell which game this is. Pick the game and teach the app its share text:

dialog.pastePlaceholder: Paste the game's share text here. It's saved as-is; fill in the fields below.
dialog.pastePlaceholderParsed: Paste the game's share text here. The fields below fill in automatically.
dialog.parseOk: Read from share text. Check the fields and save.
dialog.parseFail: Couldn't read this share text. Fill in the fields by hand; the text is still saved.
dialog.parseOtherGame: This looks like share text from {{game}}.
dialog.errRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
dialog.errMin: Enter a whole number of {{min}} or more.
dialog.teach: Teach the app to read {{game}}'s share text
dialog.reteach: This didn't read right? Teach the app this format
dialog.errRangeDec: Enter a number from {{min}} to {{max}}, with up to {{decimals}} decimals.
dialog.errMinDec: Enter a number of {{min}} or more, with up to {{decimals}} decimals.

stats.streakHelp: Streaks show current / best. Play streak: days in a row with a result. Win streak: days in a row with a win.
stats.noResultsYet: No results logged for this game yet.
stats.noDistribution: No distribution for this game yet.

share.title: Share today
share.copiedImage: Image copied. Paste it into WhatsApp, Discord…
share.error: Something went wrong. Try Download instead.
share.clipboardBlocked: The browser blocked clipboard access. Allow it for this site, or use Download.

settings.gamesHelp: Turn games on or off and change their order. Turned-off games are hidden everywhere; their results are kept.
settings.confirmDeleteGame: Delete {{game}} and all its results? This can't be undone.
settings.name: Name
settings.hasWinLoss: This game can be won or lost
settings.errUrl: Enter a full web address starting with https://
settings.errMax: Maximum must be a whole number of 1 or more.
settings.backupHelp: Your results are stored only in this browser. Export a backup now and then; import it to restore or move to another browser.
settings.importReady: Backup with {{count}} results from {{date}}. How do you want to import it?
settings.mergeHelp: Merge keeps your current data and adds the backup; for the same game and day, the most recently edited result wins. Replace deletes everything first.
settings.confirmReplace: Delete all current data and replace it with the backup?

importErr.notBackup: That file isn't a Daily Games Hub backup.
importErr.newerVersion: That backup is from a newer version of the app.
importErr.badRow: That backup has damaged results and wasn't imported.

settings.taughtHelp: Its share-text format was taught in the app.
settings.newGameHelp: Set its result type and unit, and teach it the game's share text. Games from Discover can be edited the same way with ✎.
settings.importCode: Add a game from a setup code
settings.importCodeHelp: A friend can copy a game's setup code with ✎ → Copy setup code. Only the game's settings are shared, never results.
settings.badCode: That isn't a valid setup code. Copy it again, all of it.
settings.confirmReplaceGame: You already have {{game}}. Replace its settings with the ones in this code? Your results are kept.

discover.similarHelp: Ranked by how much they have in common with the games you play.
discover.noSuggestions: No more suggestions. Browse the full list below.
discover.disclaimer: Links go to each game’s own site. Some couldn’t be checked when this list was made; if one is broken, dismiss it.

editor.lowerHelp: For scores like "$ off the real price" or "points left": the best result is the lowest.
editor.kindChanged: Results you already logged keep their saved numbers.
editor.teachHelp: Paste one share text from this game. Then click the number that is your score (and the puzzle number, if there is one). The app learns where to find them in future share texts.
editor.teachHelpBuiltIn: This game already has a built-in reader. Paste a share text here only if it reads it wrong, for example after the site changed its format. A taught format replaces the built-in one.
editor.samplePlaceholder: Paste a share text from the game here…
editor.detect: Recognize it by a line that starts with
editor.detectHelp: Usually the game's name. Pasted texts with a line starting like this are logged for this game.
editor.fromNumber: A number in the text (click it below)
editor.fromEmoji: How many times an emoji appears
editor.fromRows: The number of emoji grid lines
editor.clickToMark: Click a number to mark it as:
editor.lossIf: It's a loss when the text contains (optional)
editor.revealedIf: The answer was revealed when the text contains (optional)
editor.keepGrid: Save the emoji grid (for the share card)
editor.previewNoScore: The score isn't where it was in the example.
editor.tryAnother: Check with another day's share text (optional)
editor.tryPlaceholder: Paste a different share text to check it's read correctly…
editor.patternCleared: The example is empty, so the taught format will be removed when you save.
editor.confirmReset: Undo all your changes to {{game}}? Its results are kept.
editor.codeCopied: Setup code copied. Send it to a friend: they paste it under Settings → Add a game.
editor.errDetect: Fill in how to recognize this game's share text.
editor.errScore: Click the number in the example that is your score, or choose another source for the score.
